name: Kerkaszentkirály (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kerkaszentkirály (a white and red shield with a fish, a wavy stripe and a patriarchal cross) above the name KERKASZENTKIRÁLY in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
